_note: A child's education in the employer's own institution, or free elsewhere by reason of the employment: the cost in a similar institution in or near the locality, less recoveries, only "where the cost of such education or value of such benefit per child exceeds" the limit per month — all or nothing, on the cost before recovery (D-120 C3). This row is the limit. TY 2026-27: "₹3,000 per month" (r.15(4) Table III Sl. 3(b)–(c), Gazette 271092, p.1544). TY 2025-26: nil "if the cost … per child does not exceed one thousand rupees per month" (Rules 1962 r.3(5) proviso, consolidated rule 3, p.3). Provided by the employer, so salary only for a specified employee (OQ-10). Every regime.
